risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail on operating results, restaurant counts, revenue changes, COVID-19 costs, lease termination effects, and PPP loans. Risk tone is moderately negative due to pandemic uncertainty, labor and supply-chain disruption, seasonal fixed costs, declining same-store sales in New York and Connecticut, and uncertainty over forgiveness of $2.032 million of short-term PPP loans. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and repeated uncertainty language somewhat reduce specificity regarding future outcomes.
